bio: This restaurant's unique location may come as a surprise; and no wonder, it is located in a quiet residential area, within the Tafira Tennis Club. The name, a nod to the sport of tennis but also a statement of intent, underscores the team's philosophy and its overwhelming enthusiasm for serving up informal haute cuisine. Here, what is made abundantly clear is the desire to do things the right way, both in the kitchen (Paco Budia) and in the dining room (Héctor Suárez and Sem Suárez), in a relaxed atmosphere... although with incredibly high self-imposed standards! The menu, supported by a tasting menu, includes dishes worthy of a Grand Slam, such as squid in textures and its black ink or, for dessert, yuzu cream, lemon foam and green tea ice cream. It is sure to win you over!...
